item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba thugs kyi sgrub pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa chen po'i khog dbub thabs kyi phyag bzhes 'dod dgu'i sprin chen mchog thun snye ma
item.coloph: zhes rig 'dzin sku gsum dgongs 'dus tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen po'i phyag bzhes 'dod dgu sprin chen zhes bya ba 'di ni rgyal ba'i slob dpon grub pa'i shing rta chen po bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pa dang / rig 'dzin za rang rnam sprul sangs rgyas gnyis pa dngos byon nyi ma rgyal mtshan sogs kyi gter snying skyong zhing gter gsar spel ba'i lag len zin bris ring lugs ltas chog cha lag cha rkyen sogs dag snang chen po'i brten bcas smin nges dgos pa'i bka' nan spyi bor cod paN bcing ste/ nye bar bka' babs rigs mchog khyung ser sgam chung lcam dral nas kyang 'di ltar dgos zhes dang / yongs 'dzin mchog dga'i skyes sprul bla slob zung dang / lhag par nye gnas tshul khrims dbang rgyal sogs kyis dngos rdzas rab dkar me tog rten 'brel chen pos mtshams sbyar te yang nas yang du bskul ngor lung mthun DAk+ki'i brda lung yol med du dge byed khang chib nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs dang po'i rab dga' 'char ba'i nyin du/ rigs sngags 'dzin pa pad ma bdud 'dul gyi lung rig bden gnyis zab mo'i rgyad lung mang po gsher te gdan thog gcig tu sbyar ba'i drung yig pa seng ha nyi ri'i sgo gsum sor mo'i gdos (zlos) gar dad gsum spyi bor bzlum ste zhal brlang yol med du bgyis pa 'dis kyang / gsang sngags bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrab zab mo phyogs kun dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
